D1–D4 badges = War Deck AI lineup.

Card picker click a card to add it to the ACTIVE deck · or click an empty slot first, then a card · click a slotted card to remove

"Open in game" uses the community link format (8 base card ids; no Evo/Hero form or slot info); untested in game. Role warnings use simple name-based tags.
Scores are collection-based estimates (meta weight 0, no win-rate data). War-deck slot rule (1 Evo / 1 Hero / 1 Wild) is confirmed by a third-party source only. Data embedded at build time; regenerate with gen_dash.py.
